issues.title: [Security] Upgrade jaraco-context 6.0.1 -> 6.1.0 (High)
issues.body:
Package: jaraco-context (pip, dev)
Current -> fixed: 6.0.1 -> 6.1.0 (minor)
CVEs: CVE-2026-23949
Files: requirements/development.txt
Risk notes: Low risk. Transitive only, pulled in by keyring (`# via keyring`). Confirmed at HEAD with pip-audit.

Acceptance criteria:
- Dependency upgraded and lockfile updated (diff limited to this package)
- Existing tests pass (targeted tests, compared to baseline)
- PR description lists CVEs, version change, commands run, and results
- If tests fail because of the bump, stop and explain instead of forcing it

issues.title: [Security] Upgrade python-multipart 0.0.29 -> 0.0.31 (High)
issues.body:
Package: python-multipart (pip, dev)
Current -> fixed: 0.0.29 -> 0.0.31 (patch)

issues.title: [Security] Upgrade urllib3 2.7.0 -> 2.8.0 (High)
issues.body:
Package: urllib3 (pip, runtime)
Current -> fixed: 2.7.0 -> 2.8.0 (minor)
CVEs: CVE-2026-97687, CVE-2026-97689, CVE-2026-97688
Files: requirements/base.txt, requirements/development.txt (constraint in requirements/base.in: urllib3>=2.6.3,<3.0.0)
Risk notes: Runtime dependency. pyproject.toml warns docker/testcontainers are sensitive to the requests/urllib3 versions; run tests/testcontainers if possible. Confirmed at HEAD with pip-audit.

Acceptance criteria:
- Dependency upgraded and lockfile updated (diff limited to this package)

issues.title: [Security] Upgrade pytest 7.4.4 -> 9.0.3 (Moderate)
issues.body:
Package: pytest (pip, dev)
Current -> fixed: 7.4.4 -> 9.0.3 (major)
CVEs: CVE-2025-71176
Files: requirements/development.txt (constraint in pyproject.toml development extra: pytest<10.0.0; also required by superset-extensions-cli)
Risk notes: MAJOR bump across two versions (7 -> 9). High risk of breaking tests and pytest plugins (pytest-asyncio, pytest-cov, pytest-mock, pytest-xdist); expected to need a human. Confirmed at HEAD with pip-audit.

Acceptance criteria:
- Dependency upgraded and lockfile updated (diff limited to this package)

issues.title: [Security] Upgrade fast-uri 3.1.7 -> 3.1.8 (Moderate)
issues.body:
Package: fast-uri (npm, dev)
Current -> fixed: 3.1.7 -> 3.1.8 (patch)
CVEs: CVE-2026-86472 (GHSA-hrr3-gc8f-f4qj)
Files: superset-embedded-sdk/package.json, superset-embedded-sdk/package-lock.json
Risk notes: Low risk. Transitive dev dependency (webpack -> schema-utils -> ajv -> fast-uri). superset-embedded-sdk/package.json has no override yet (superset-frontend already overrides to ^3.1.8). Confirmed at HEAD with `npm audit --package-lock-only`.
